patterns.note: Dominant use of a full-height, split-screen layout where content is divided vertically or horizontally, often with contrasting background colors or content types.
Headings are consistently presented in an extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif font, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller body text.
A stark, high-contrast monochrome palette of black, white, and various shades of gray is used throughout, emphasizing typography and layout.

Scrolling triggers full-screen content transitions where entire sections or split panels slide into view, often from the bottom or side, replacing the previous content with a deliberate, animated reveal.
Each content 'section' appears to occupy the full viewport height, with new content revealed through the scroll-triggered animations rather than traditional vertical stacking.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen, scroll-triggered content reveal system where different content blocks or split-screen panels animate into view. This is achieved by sliding elements horizontally and vertically, often with a staggered effect, as the user scrolls. The initial loading screen also uses a canvas animation for the logo reveal.
Typography is used as a primary design element, with oversized, bold sans-serif text dominating the visual space, often acting as a focal point or section title within the split layouts.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, contrasting with smaller, regular-weight body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous negative space, especially within the split-screen layouts.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its full-screen, scroll-driven content transitions. Instead of a traditional scroll, entire content blocks or split panels animate into and out of view, creating a dynamic, almost presentation-like experience that feels highly interactive and deliberate.
